analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price(109,545 KRW) vs SMA5(110,812 KRW)/SMA20(108,636 KRW)/SMA50(105,847 KRW): Short/Mid-term trend position diagnosis: Below SMA5, above SMA20, above SMA50.
· Position vs SMA100(116,547 KRW)/SMA200(96,991 KRW): Mid/Long-term trend strength assessment: Below SMA100, above SMA200.
· 52-week Position(59.0%) + Historical significance of current price range: Consolidation near the midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (56.0→51.5) + Neutral assessment + Directional interpretation: Continued consolidation in the neutral zone.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (286.6936→209.1359) + Improvement diagnosis + Trend reversal signal indication: Weakening momentum continues, weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band 108,636 KRW) + Bandwidth level interpretation: Consolidation near the middle band, bandwidth slowing expansion at 10.91%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support Level (103,800 KRW) + Basis: Above Pivot S1(101,485 KRW) and 20-day low(100,000 KRW).
· Swing Resistance Level (110,910 KRW) + Significance of breakout: Close to SMA5(110,812 KRW), potential for short-term bullish reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low / Sideways) + Trend interpretation: 5-day low at 108,445 KRW, 20-day low at 100,000 KRW. Higher 5-day low, sideways pattern relative to 20-day low.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.93x) + Movement conviction assessment: Volume ratio at 0.93 of 5-day average indicates lack of conviction, low reliability.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) + Entry/Wait-and-see conditions specification: Accumulation phase, maintain wait-and-see until directional clarity.
